name: surgical_patch
description: Applies a surgical chunk replacement, line range edit, or unified diff to target file using LEX multi-strategy engine.

path.description: Relative path to target file in workspace

target.description: Exact or approximate source text chunk to replace

start_line.description: 1-indexed start line number for range replacement (optional)

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line number for range replacement (optional)

content.description: Full file content for creation or rewrite (optional)
